title: MCOS
description: A Modpack used for our Roleplay Server
body:
**MCOS**

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**About**

MCOS is a small Project about giving a good Roleplay experience on our Server, it started in early 2019 and since then we have made many changes, the most recent of them being our move to Modrinth.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Features**

MCOS features Mods fitted for a good Roleplay experience, adding features like decorative Blocks, Utilities, a custom Discord Integration and a customized Menu.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**1.20.2 Alpha Version**

We are currently working on a Version for Minecraft 1.20.2, but its still far away from being complete. The new Version will feature greater performance and a better user experience.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**Important**

*Due to issues the Version for Minecraft 1.16.5 is temporarily only available on CurseForge.*

CurseForge - https://curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/mcos

*THIS MODPACK SHOULD ONLY BE USED WITH THE MCOS SERVER*

Discord - https://discord.gg/GhJyrmKHqg

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
